description: Change one credit in place by credit_id: its role or name, or who it is linked to (a Vidreno username, which they are asked to accept, or an invite email, which is sent straight away; null clears). The credit keeps its id, position and, when only the role or name changes, its accepted or linked state. Returns the full credit list.

email.description: Set the invite email (a new address sends the invite now; replaces any username); null clears it.

film_id.description: The film's public id (from list_films / get_film).

name.description: New name as it should appear.

username.description: Link the credit to a Vidreno filmmaker by username (they are asked to accept; replaces any email); null unlinks it.

name: update_film_credit
title: Edit a credit
